# Indices: REST API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-15 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

13 REST endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Aggregates

### Custom Bars (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{indicesTicker}/range/{multiplier}/{timespan}/{from}/{to}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/aggregates/custom-bars.md)

Retrieve aggregated historical OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and value data for a specified index over a custom date range and time interval in Eastern Time (ET).

- **Params:** `indicesTicker`\*, `multiplier`\*, `timespan`\*, `from`\*, `to`\*, `sort`, `limit`
- **Returns:** `ticker queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `c h l o t`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic–Advanced all

### Daily Ticker Summary (OHLC)

`GET /v1/open-close/{indicesTicker}/{date}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/aggregates/daily-ticker-summary.md)

Retrieve the opening and closing prices for a specific index on a given date, along with any pre-market and after-hours trade prices.

- **Params:** `indicesTicker`\*, `date`\*
- **Returns:** `afterHours close from high low open preMarket symbol`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic–Advanced all

### Previous Day Bar (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{indicesTicker}/prev` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/aggregates/previous-day-bar.md)

Retrieve the previous trading day's open, high, low, and close (OHLC) data for a specified index ticker.

- **Params:** `indicesTicker`\*
- **Returns:** `ticker queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `c h l o t`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

## Market Operations

### Market Holidays

`GET /v1/marketstatus/upcoming` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/market-operations/market-holidays.md)

Retrieve upcoming market holidays and their corresponding open/close times.

- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Market Status

`GET /v1/marketstatus/now` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/market-operations/market-status.md)

Retrieve the current trading status for various exchanges and overall financial markets.

- **Returns:** `afterHours currencies earlyHours exchanges indicesGroups market serverTime` · currencies: `crypto fx` · exchanges: `nasdaq nyse otc` · indicesGroups: `cccy cgi dow_jones ftse_russell msci mstar mstarc nasdaq s_and_p societe_generale`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated in real time

## Snapshots

### Indices Snapshot

`GET /v3/snapshot/indices` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/snapshots/indices-snapshot.md)

Retrieve snapshot data for one or more indices, including their current value, recent performance metrics, and trading session details.

- **Params:** `ticker` (.any_of .gte .gt .lte .lt), `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `error last_updated market_status message name session ticker timeframe type value` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Unified Snapshot

`GET /v3/snapshot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/snapshots/unified-snapshot.md)

Retrieve unified snapshots of market data for multiple asset classes including stocks, options, forex, and cryptocurrencies in a single request.

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt .any_of), `type`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `error fmv_last_updated last_updated market_status message name session ticker timeframe type value` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

## Technical Indicators

### Exponential Moving Average (EMA)

`GET /v1/indicators/ema/{indicesTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/technical-indicators/exponential-moving-average.md)

Retrieve the Exponential Moving Average (EMA) for a specified ticker over a defined time range.

- **Params:** `indicesTicker`\*, `timestamp` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `timespan`, `adjusted`, `window`, `series_type`, `expand_underlying`, `order`, `limit`
- **Returns:** results: `underlying values` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic–Advanced all

## Tickers

### All Tickers

`GET /v3/reference/tickers` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/tickers/all-tickers.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive list of ticker symbols supported by Massive across various asset classes (e.g., stocks, indices, forex, crypto).

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `type`, `market`, `exchange`, `cusip`, `cik`, `date`, `search`, `active`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `active base_currency_name base_currency_symbol cik composite_figi currency_name currency_symbol delisted_utc last_updated_utc locale market name primary_exchange share_class_figi ticker type` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated hourly · history Basic–Advanced all

### Ticker Overview

`GET /v3/reference/tickers/{ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/indices/tickers/ticker-overview.md)

Retrieve comprehensive details for a single ticker supported by Massive that is active as-of a given date.

- **Params:** `ticker`\*, `date`
- **Returns:** results: `active address branding cik composite_figi currency_name delisted_utc description homepage_url list_date locale market market_cap name phone_number primary_exchange round_lot share_class_figi share_class_shares_outstanding sic_code sic_description ticker ticker_root ticker_suffix total_employees type weighted_shares_outstanding`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated hourly · history Basic–Advanced all
